name: SDA Agentic AI Bootcamp - Aug 2026 - Online 02
sources: SDA Agentic AI Bootcamp - Bootcamp Syllabus, Saudi Digital Academy 2026

chapters.title: Week 1 - Welcome and course overview
chapters.teaches: Orientation only: the syllabus and how the bootcamp runs. No tools.
chapters.teaches_ar: تعريف فقط: خطة المقرر وطريقة سير المعسكر. بلا أدوات.

chapters.title: Week 1 - Environment setup
topics_covered: OpenAI account and API key setup
GitHub account and personal access token setup
chapters.teaches: Set up the local toolchain: VS Code, Colab, and API keys for OpenAI and GitHub.
chapters.teaches_ar: تجهيز بيئة العمل المحلية: VS Code وColab ومفاتيح API لـOpenAI وGitHub.

chapters.title: Week 2 - Generative AI, AI ethics and transformer foundations
chapters.teaches: Concepts only: how LLMs and transformers work, and the ethics around them.
chapters.teaches_ar: مفاهيم فقط: كيف تعمل النماذج اللغوية الكبيرة والمحوّلات، والأخلاقيات المحيطة بها.

chapters.title: Week 2 - BERT and Hugging Face workflows
chapters.teaches: Classify and compare text with BERT through Hugging Face transformers, then fine-tune it.
chapters.teaches_ar: تصنيف النصوص ومقارنتها بـBERT عبر مكتبة transformers من Hugging Face، ثم ضبطه بدقة.

chapters.title: Week 2 - Prompt engineering and LLM prompt optimization
topics_covered: optimizing LLM as a judge prompts
chapters.teaches: Call the OpenAI API directly and shape answers by prompt engineering and chaining, with DSPy shown for optimization.
chapters.teaches_ar: استدعاء OpenAI API مباشرة وتوجيه الإجابات بهندسة الأوامر وتسلسلها، مع عرض DSPy للتحسين.

chapters.title: Week 2 - RAG fundamentals, embeddings and vector databases
topics_covered: building a simple RAG system from scratch
build a research paper assistant using RAG
chapters.teaches: Build RAG from scratch: chunk, embed, index with FAISS, retrieve, then answer.
chapters.teaches_ar: بناء RAG من الصفر: التقطيع، ثم التضمين، ثم الفهرسة بـFAISS، ثم الاسترجاع، ثم الإجابة.

chapters.title: Week 2 - RAG evaluation and checkpoint
topics_covered: LLM as a jury with Evidently
chapters.teaches: Measure a RAG system with Ragas and Evidently, including LLM-as-jury scoring.
chapters.teaches_ar: قياس نظام RAG بـRagas وEvidently، بما في ذلك التقييم بلجنة من النماذج اللغوية.

chapters.title: Week 3 - LangChain implementation for document QA workflows
chapters.teaches: Rebuild document QA on LangChain: splitters, a FAISS vector store, and chains over documents and Wikipedia.
chapters.teaches_ar: إعادة بناء الإجابة عن أسئلة المستندات على LangChain: أدوات التقسيم، ومخزن متجهات FAISS، وسلاسل تعمل على المستندات وويكيبيديا.

chapters.title: Week 3 - LLM evaluation and fine-tuning overview
chapters.teaches: Evaluate an LLM with basic metrics, then fine-tune with PEFT and LoRA.
chapters.teaches_ar: تقييم نموذج لغوي بمقاييس أساسية، ثم ضبطه بدقة باستخدام PEFT وLoRA.

chapters.title: Week 3 - FastAPI and Streamlit for AI applications
chapters.teaches: Serve an AI application: a FastAPI backend and a Streamlit interface.
chapters.teaches_ar: نشر تطبيق ذكاء اصطناعي: خادم بـFastAPI وواجهة بـStreamlit.

chapters.title: Week 3 - Building your first agent
topics_covered: converting a RAG pipeline into an agent
chapters.teaches: Turn a RAG pipeline into an agent that chooses and calls its own tools.
chapters.teaches_ar: تحويل مسار RAG إلى وكيل يختار أدواته ويستدعيها بنفسه.

chapters.title: Week 4 - Debugging and controlling agents
chapters.teaches: Control an agent with an explicit reason-act-observe loop, and debug one that misbehaves.
chapters.teaches_ar: التحكم في الوكيل بحلقة صريحة من التفكير ثم الفعل ثم الملاحظة، وتصحيح وكيل يسيء التصرف.

pins_note: pins, installs_unpinned and legacy_api are read from the course notebooks by `python -m src.curriculum`. A package under installs_unpinned has no version bound in the notebook, so a student installs whatever is newest on the day they run it.
material_note: material_edits are read by `python -m src.curriculum`: every langchain import in the notebooks, checked against the source of the newest release at its tag on GitHub, with the replacement found the same way. runs_as_pinned is true when the notebook's own pin keeps it on the old line, so the edit is for the day the course moves, not a break today.
